findings.title: Every played row's `points` is summed as FBL points without checking its source: old-collector Sports.ru ФО, bonus-kept rows and rows derived from an uncounted ФО get into standings, facts and the in-season update
findings.location: /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/season.js:370-377 (teamPoints), 146-162 (perGame), 688-707 (withBoxScores only covers the ESPN 2-US-day window); /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/season-ui.js:142-147 (player card total), 207 (topPlayers); /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/scripts/notify-transfers.mjs:22,29,82 (the bot uses the raw snapshot, never ESPN boxes); feeds: /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/scripts/season_watch.py:66 (merge_full keeps a player's entry from the previous snapshot), /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/scripts/collect_sports_current.py:215-216 (ROW_SCORE) and 879 (published gamePoints.formula)
findings.claim: The app reads g.points of any played row as FBL points; nothing in src/ or scripts/*.mjs ever reads pointsSource. Inside the ESPN window withBoxScores hides this. Once a game leaves the window (US yesterday and today), and always in the Telegram bot, the row's own number counts as it is. Three kinds of rows are not FBL points: (a) rows of main's older collector (no pointsSource, Sports.ru's raw ФО with the result bonus and the +2 minutes rule, or 0 before Sports.ru counts); (b) SPORTS_WITH_BONUS rows, which keep the result bonus by design; (c) ROW_SCORE rows taken from a ФО Sports.ru has not counted yet (0 - bonus - minutes point). Old-format rows reach the app in three ways: the data/season-live file until the new watcher run's first full collection lands; any player whose page fails, because merge_full puts back his old entry; and the published gamePoints.formula, which still says '+2 for 10+ minutes, else +1', so neither the app nor a reader can tell the format apart.
findings.reproduction:
Script: after-window.mjs, on the real snapshot (scratchpad/live/sports-current.json, played rows with no pointsSource and points 0) and today's transfers (allTransfers -> 20). On 23.10 09:00Z the ESPN window is 20261022/20261023, so the opening games are outside it.

A) Rows as they are now (Sports.ru has not counted): teamPoints is 0 for every team. The FBL values are Texas 84, Black Jacks 62, Алачанян 45, School Shooters 44, Karagali 18, Saint P 17, Balkan 16.

B) The same old-format rows after Sports.ru counts them (ФО = FBL + 1 for 10+ min + result bonus). Shown vs FBL: Texas 93 vs 84, Black Jacks 59 vs 62, School Shooters 46 vs 44, Karagali 16 vs 18, Balkan 18 vs 16, Saint P 18 vs 17. Example: Maxey shows 30 (Sports.ru ФО) instead of 26.

C) The same games as new-collector BOX rows: 84/62/45/44/18/17/16/0, which is correct.

In-season update (bot-pergame.mjs): the bot computes perGame from the published rows. For the 64 players who played, it is 0.44 FP/game low on average (Paul George 14.98 vs 16.47, SGA 28.30 vs 29.67, Maxey 21.78 vs 23.05). That is the 'ФО/матч' printed in the Telegram briefs and the input to every gain.

merge_full (season_watch.py) with Maxey's page missing from the full collection keeps his old row {points:0, played:true}, with no pointsSource.

ROW_SCORE: Maxey's real page with one unreadable box cell gives parse_games points -4 (pointsSource ROW_SCORE, sportsPoints 0) instead of 26. The app and the bot accept that row as it is.
findings.impact: Once the ESPN window has passed, and in Telegram at any time, the league table ('Очки'), the Teams tab facts, 'Лучшие в сезоне', the player-card season totals and the 'ФО за матч' estimates behind every transfer verdict can show Sports.ru's ФO (bonus and +2 included), a 0 for an uncounted game, or -4 from an uncounted ФО, all presented as FBL Yahoo points. Places can change: in case B Texas leads by 34 instead of 22.
findings.fix: Score a played row only when its points come from detailed stats. In one shared normaliser, used by the app (season-ui scoreBoxes) and by notify-transfers.mjs before perGame/teamPoints, keep g.points only if g.source==='ESPN' or g.pointsSource==='BOX'. Every other played row gets points:null and unscored:true. teamPoints, windowFact, topPlayers and the card total skip it and say 'Sports.ru ещё не посчитал'. perGame leaves it out of the update. If a ROW_SCORE/CALENDAR fallback is kept at all, accept it only when sportsPoints is non-zero. In the collector, change gamePoints.formula to the GP formula and add a version field, so the app can refuse an old-format snapshot. In merge_full, never put back a player entry whose rows have no pointsSource.

findings.title: Help texts and docs describe the season points wrongly: 'ФО Sports.ru minus bonuses' and 'В игре = matches Sports.ru has not counted'
findings.location: /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/forecast-text.js:99 (seasonMethod().overview items 1-2, shown under «Как считается» on the overview, season-ui.js:695/727); /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/season-ui.js:147 (player-card footnote); /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md:254; /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/data/league-rules.json:121 (scoringFormula.gamePoints); /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/README.md:9; /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/scripts/collect_sports_current.py:879 (published gamePoints.formula); comments /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/live.js:3, /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/season.js:134 and 368
findings.claim: The help text says points are computed as 'из ФО Sports.ru вычитаются его бонус и лишнее очко за 10+ минут' and that '«В игре» — матчи, которые Sports.ru ещё не засчитал'. The code does neither. Points come from detailed stats: the ESPN box inside the window, Sports.ru's detailed columns (BOX) outside it. Finished games Sports.ru has not counted go into 'Очки', not 'В игре' (the standings note on the same screen says exactly that, so the two texts contradict each other). The player-card footnote '* по протоколу ESPN: Sports.ru этот матч ещё не посчитал' is printed for every finished game in the window, including games Sports.ru has already counted. ACCEPTANCE.md:254 and league-rules.json scoringFormula.gamePoints describe game points as Sports.ru's points minus the bonus (ACCEPTANCE also leaves out the minutes point). README.md:9 says the FBL formula is 'Sports.ru's without the team result bonus', which leaves out that Yahoo gives +1 per GP instead of +2/+1. The collector publishes the formula as '+2 for 10+ minutes, else +1'. The comments in live.js and season.js repeat the Sports.ru-derived description.
findings.reproduction: windows.mjs/totals.mjs on today's data: all 64 played Sports.ru rows have ФО 0 (not counted). The race gives 'В игре' 0 for every team, so the column is hidden, while those same uncounted games are in 'Очки': 84/62/45/44/18/17/16/0. Subtracting bonuses from ФО, as the help says, would give Maxey 0-3-1 = -4, not the 26 shown. footnote.mjs: a counted Maxey row {points 26, pointsSource BOX, sportsPoints 30} after withBoxScores becomes source 'ESPN', so the card prints 'Sports.ru этот матч ещё не посчитал'. `node -e` on seasonMethod().overview prints both false sentences. The string on collect_sports_current.py:879 is literally '..., +2 for 10+ minutes, else +1'.
findings.impact: The owner reads, in the app and the docs, that FBL points are Sports.ru's ФО with bonuses removed and that uncounted games are kept separate in 'В игре'. Neither is true. The published snapshot even declares the old +2/+1 rule.
findings.fix: In forecast-text.js:99: 'Очки — по формуле FBL (Yahoo) из статистики матча: протокол ESPN за последние два дня, затем подробная статистика Sports.ru; ФО Sports.ru не используются'. Also: '«В игре» — матчи, которые идут сейчас (предварительно по протоколу ESPN)'. In season-ui.js:147, show the footnote only when the row had no pointsSource 'BOX' before ESPN replaced it, or reword it to '* по протоколу ESPN'. Correct ACCEPTANCE.md:254, league-rules.json gamePoints and README.md:9 to 'box score + 1 per GP, from detailed stats'. Set the collector's gamePoints.formula to '...-PF+1 per game played'. Fix the comments in live.js:3 and season.js:134/368.

findings.title: Running points are added to every current roster holder, ignoring holdings: a shadowed second holder and a buyer after tip-off get live points that the facts never give them
findings.location: /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/standings.js:47 (leagueRace `now`); /home/user/Nba-draft-simulator/src/season-ui.js:319 (ahead) and 122-129 (livePoints)
findings.claim: teamPoints counts a game only through inStint: a shared player scores only for the team that held him first, and a game tipped off before a move scores for the seller. The running ESPN points of a game in progress skip this. leagueRace adds running.get(id) for every id on today's roster, and the Teams tab ahead() does the same. So while a game runs, the same player's live points count for two teams when another FBL team holds him later (scoringRule FIRST_HOLDER_ONLY). They also count for a buyer who bought him after tip-off. At the final whistle the points jump to the right team. This breaks the league's holding rule, not the Yahoo formula.
findings.reproduction: shadow.mjs: ESPN in-progress box of OKC-SA (8:22 3rd) plus today's snapshot. I add a hypothetical breach: Volga Pirates buys Chet Holmgren on 20.10 at 10:00 MSK while Texas 76 still holds him. stints() marks Volga's holding as shadowed (shadowed()=true). leagueRace then gives Texas Очки 51 / В игре 22 (Holmgren 13 included) and Volga Очки 0 / В игре 13 (Holmgren 13). The same 13 live points count twice. Once the game is final, Volga's 13 disappear, because teamPoints and inStint exclude them.
findings.impact: While games run, the overview's 'В игре' column, the order of the places and the Teams tab forecast give a breaching team (or a buyer after tip-off) points it will not keep, and the same points appear twice in the league.
findings.fix: In leagueRace (and in season-ui ahead/teamKpis), add a running entry for team t only if one of t's stints covers that game: build the stints once, then add running.get(id).points only when inStint({date:x.day, tip:x.game.date}, s) holds for a stint s with s.team===t and s.playerId===id.

findings.title: Fallbacks without a box score derive FBL points from Sports.ru's ФО, which is 0 until Sports.ru counts the game; a missing box column switches to them with no alarm
findings.location: scripts/collect_sports_current.py: row_points (the `elif won is not None:` ROW_SCORE branch), fbl_points (SPORTS_WITH_BONUS and CALENDAR), unreadable_games (checks only ФО and МИН), parse_games (`if points is None and played: continue`)
findings.claim: When any of the 13 box columns is missing or unreadable, a played row's FBL points become ФО − result bonus − minutes point (ROW_SCORE), or ФО − minutes point with the result bonus left in (SPORTS_WITH_BONUS: Sports.ru's ФO leaking in as FBL points). On every row Sports.ru has not counted yet, ФО is 0, so the result is a negative fake game. Nothing raises the alarm: unreadable_games looks only at ФО and МИН, so refuse_reason lets the snapshot publish. Separately, a played row whose ФО cell is not a number is dropped even though its box score is complete. Today this is latent: every real table has all 13 box columns (64/64 pages now, 1,834/1,834 rows in 2025/26).
findings.reproduction:
Script: .../conformance/sports-collect/scripts/fallback.py, run on the real Maxey page 2038002 (21.10 at NY, 39:34; ФО shows 0; box 26 = ESPN 26).
(b) Head ПХ renamed to ПЕР: parse_games returns points -4, pointsSource ROW_SCORE, sportsPoints 0; unreadable_games returns False.
(c) Box cells empty, ФО 0: points -4, ROW_SCORE.
(d) Also no row score and no calendar score: points -1, SPORTS_WITH_BONUS.
(a) ФО cell '–' with the box filled: parse_games returns [] (the game vanishes).
(e) Head renamed after Sports.ru counts (ФО 30): ROW_SCORE 26, which is right, so the derivation only fails before counting. On opening night that window lasted 10+ hours.
pergame.mjs: Maxey perGame 21.59 with the -4 row, against 23.05 with the true 26.
findings.impact: If Sports.ru renames or drops one box column, every game it has not counted yet is published as a negative game: Maxey's 26 becomes -4, so the team total is 30 points low and per-game values drop. The Telegram notifier always reads the raw snapshot, so it sees these rows at once. The app's standings and in-season updates see them once the game leaves the ESPN window (US yesterday and today). The data is published silently, with no error or refusal.
findings.fix: Make the box score mandatory. In unreadable_games (and parse_games), a table without every BOX column (either В20 or В2О counts for two-point attempts) is a layout change: mark gameTable UNREADABLE so refuse_reason fires. Remove the ROW_SCORE, CALENDAR and SPORTS_WITH_BONUS derivations. A played row whose box cells cannot be read stays unscored (e.g. points None, pointsSource 'PENDING'), and consumers skip it until it can be read. Change the gate in parse_games to `if points is None and played and box_points(cs, col, minutes) is None: continue`, so a non-numeric ФО never drops a box-scored row.

findings.title: MISMATCH fires on every row Sports.ru has not counted yet
findings.location: scripts/collect_sports_current.py row_points (`if won is not None and round(base - box, 2) != result_bonus(...) + minutes_extra(...)`), and in main() the errors entry «N box scores disagree with Sports.ru's points»
findings.claim: The check compares the box score with ФО even while ФО is 0 because Sports.ru has not counted the game. So every fresh played row is flagged, and a real disagreement looks the same as the normal wait.
findings.reproduction: scripts/pipeline.py (collect → fbl_points → game_points_summary on the 8 real pages): every row is BOX with pointsCheck MISMATCH; the summary has mismatches 8, and main() would add the error «8 box scores disagree with Sports.ru's points». Over the 64 current pages: 64/64 flagged. Over the 1,834 counted 2025/26 regular-season rows: 0 flagged.
findings.impact: Points are not affected. But gamePoints.mismatches and the snapshot errors report false disagreements for hours after every game night, so the check cannot catch a real discrepancy.
findings.fix: When sportsPoints == 0 and the identity fails, set pointsCheck 'UNCOUNTED' instead of 'MISMATCH' and leave it out of game_points_summary's mismatches. Count MISMATCH only for rows with a nonzero ФО.

findings.title: Sports.ru's provisional box lines disagree with ESPN on 4 of 64 opening rows; the app shows ESPN's points for two US days, then Sports.ru's
findings.location: scripts/collect_sports_current.py row_points/box_points (the Sports.ru line is used as soon as it appears, before Sports.ru counts it), together with src/season.js withBoxScores (ESPN overrides only games on the scoreboards of US yesterday and today, src/live.js:30)
findings.claim: Both sources apply the Yahoo formula to detailed stats, but the stats differ. On 4 of 64 played rows, Sports.ru's line (shown while ФО is still 0) has an event that ESPN's box score and ESPN's play-by-play both lack. Nothing reconciles the two, so the same game's FBL points change when it leaves the ESPN window. The Telegram notifier reads only the Sports.ru line.
findings.reproduction:
Scripts allbox.py and compare.mjs (collector BOX points against liveGamePoints on online2/sum-*.json): 60 equal, 4 differ.
- Paul George 20.10: 32 vs 31 (БШ 1 vs BLK 0).
- Andre Drummond 21.10: 19 vs 21 (П 1 vs TO 0; ESPN's play-by-play shows only a defensive goaltending violation).
- Jayson Tatum 20.10: 6 vs 5 (ПХ 1 vs STL 0; none of the game's 17 play-by-play steals is his).
- Jalen Brunson 21.10: 13 vs 12 (ПХ 1 vs STL 0).
In all four, ESPN's play-by-play agrees with ESPN's box score.
findings.impact: Those games' points shift by +1, +1, +1 and -2 once they leave ESPN's two-day window. Team totals and per-game values then move by 1–2 points with no game played, and Telegram shows different numbers from the app in the meantime.
findings.fix: Treat a Sports.ru line as provisional until Sports.ru has counted it (ФО 0 and the identity fails). The collector already calls ESPN: have it store the ESPN final box points for games of the last two days (e.g. espnPoints on the row), prefer them while the row is uncounted, and flag the row when both sources are present and differ. Once Sports.ru counts the game, the identity (ФО = box + bonus + 1 for 10+ minutes) confirms Sports.ru's final line.

findings.title: merge_full republishes a failed player's previous game rows, including rows from the old collector
findings.location: scripts/season_watch.py merge_full, last line: `for sid,p in (cur.get('players') or {}).items():full.setdefault('players',{}).setdefault(sid,p)`
findings.claim: This line is meant to keep players the watcher took from a roster. It applies to every player, though: one whose page failed in the full collection (main() skips him) is put back with his previous snapshot's games. Right after the switch from main's collector, those are raw Sports.ru rows with no pointsSource: today 0 instead of the box score, later ФО with the result bonus and the +2 minutes rule.
findings.reproduction: Script: scripts/merge.py. The full collection holds the 8 freshly parsed players minus Maxey; cur is the live snapshot (main's collector). merge_full gives Maxey [('2026-10-21','39:34',0,None)] instead of BOX 26, while Duren keeps BOX 25. pergame.mjs: Maxey perGame 21.78 with the stale row, 23.05 with the BOX row.
findings.impact: Whenever a page fails (rate limits or timeouts; MIN_COLLECTED still publishes with up to 10% of the pool missing), that player's stale or old-formula rows are published as current. They count in team totals once outside the ESPN window, and in Telegram straight away.
findings.fix: Carry over only players taken from a roster (`if p.get('fromRoster')`). Or carry the others with stale: True and only their rows with pointsSource 'BOX', never rows without a pointsSource.

findings.title: False statements about how game points are computed
findings.location: scripts/collect_sports_current.py main(): gamePoints.formula and the comment above it; docs/ACCEPTANCE.md:254; data/league-rules.json scoringFormula.gamePoints; docs/SCORING_AUDIT.md:61
findings.claim: Every snapshot this collector writes says gamePoints.formula = 'FBL: PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK-(FGA-FGM)-(FTA-FTM)-2*TOV-PF, +2 for 10+ minutes, else +1'. The code uses +1 per game played (GAME_PLAYED). The docs still describe game points as Sports.ru's points minus the result bonus, read from the club calendar's score. ACCEPTANCE.md:254 also leaves out the minutes point. league-rules.json and SCORING_AUDIT.md:61 give only the ФО-minus-bonuses derivation. In fact the collector scores each row's box score, and the calendars never carry a score.
findings.reproduction: grep shows the formula string in main()'s out dict. Real pages: 64/64 played rows and 1,834/1,834 2025/26 rows are pointsSource BOX. The club calendars have 0 of 2,394 games with a score (live/sports-current.json, and parse_calendar on today's pages: 0 scores in 79 games each).
findings.impact: The published data and the docs state the old +2/+1 rule and an indirect ФО-minus-bonus method, which contradicts the league's Yahoo formula. Anyone checking the data against the docs is misled.
findings.fix: Set gamePoints.formula to 'FBL (Yahoo): PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK-(FGA-FGM)-(FTA-FTM)-2*TOV-PF+1 per game played, from each Sports.ru game row's box score (2О+3О/В20+В3О, Ш/ВШ, О, ПБ, ПР, ПХ, БШ, П, Ф)'. State the same in ACCEPTANCE.md:254, league-rules.json gamePoints and SCORING_AUDIT.md:61, adding that ФО is kept as sportsPoints only as a cross-check (ФО = box + result bonus + 1 for 10+ minutes).

findings.title: Season-tab «Как считается» says FBL points are Sports.ru ФО minus bonus and minus the 10+ point (an indirect derivation); the code computes them from Sports.ru's detailed box stats
findings.location: src/forecast-text.js:99 (seasonMethod().overview[0], rendered by src/season-ui.js:727)
findings.claim: Text shown: «Очки — по формуле FBL (Yahoo): статистика матча и +1 за сыгранный матч, без бонуса за результат команды (из ФО Sports.ru вычитаются его бонус и лишнее очко за 10+ минут)…». The bracket describes FBL points as Sports.ru's ФО corrected backwards. The collector does something else: row_points/box_points apply the Yahoo formula to the game table's own columns (2О, В20, 3О, В3О, Ш, ВШ, ПБ, ПР, Ф, ПХ, П, БШ, О), set pointsSource 'BOX', and use Sports.ru's ФО only as a cross-check (MISMATCH). Subtracting from ФО is only the fallback (ROW_SCORE/CALENDAR).
findings.reproduction: python3 /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Nba-draft-simulator/bb5a3e80-4ef5-52c7-bdfc-4c0abaeb739b/scratchpad/conformance/statements/repro.py, section 1. On the Jokic row of the test fixture (away win 118:128, 18:15): with ФО 32 the code gives points=28.0 from BOX, and the stated method gives 28. With ФО 0, as on 21.10 when Sports.ru had not yet counted the opening games, the code still gives 28.0 from BOX (pointsCheck MISMATCH), while the stated method gives 0−3−1 = −4. The text was rendered with node -e "import('./src/forecast-text.js').then(m=>console.log(m.seasonMethod().overview[0]))".
findings.impact: Users and the league owner read that FBL points are reverse-engineered from Sports.ru's ФО. That is the opposite of the owner's instruction (Yahoo formula computed from Sports.ru's detailed stats) and does not match what the code does. Followed literally, it gives wrong points whenever ФО is 0 or late (−4 instead of 28 above).
findings.fix: Replace the bracket with: «(считается по подробной статистике матча на Sports.ru: PTS+REB+AST+ST+BLK+FGM−FGA+FTM−FTA−2·TO−PF и +1 за сыгранный матч; ФО Sports.ru — только для сверки)».

findings.title: Games still carrying Sports.ru's result bonus (pointsSource SPORTS_WITH_BONUS) are shown and summed as FBL ФО with no label, while the UI says «без бонуса за результат»
findings.location: scripts/collect_sports_current.py:306-341 (fbl_points, SPORTS_WITH_BONUS branch); src/season-ui.js:139-147 (seasonLivePanel), src/season.js teamPoints/perGame; src/forecast-text.js:99 and src/season-ui.js:468 (the «без бонуса» statements)
findings.claim: When a played row has neither box columns nor a score, and no club calendar has the result, the collector publishes points = Sports.ru ФO − 1 with the result bonus still in and marks pointsSource 'SPORTS_WITH_BONUS'. Nothing in src/ reads pointsSource or sportsPoints (grep finds no match), and collector errors are never shown. The UI therefore shows this Sports.ru-derived number as FBL «ФО». Only ESPN rows get a «*» mark. Meanwhile every caption states the points are «без бонуса за результат».
findings.reproduction: repro.py, section 1: a table with head Дата/Соперник/МИН/ФО/С (no box, no score), Jokic away-win row with ФО 32, then fbl_points(players, {}). Result: points=31.0, source=SPORTS_WITH_BONUS. The Yahoo FBL value is 28, so the +3 away-win bonus is still included. Checks: grep -n 'pointsSource\|sportsPoints\|SPORTS_WITH_BONUS' src/*.js returns nothing; grep '\.errors' src/*.js returns nothing.
findings.impact: On a Sports.ru layout change or a missing score, Sports.ru's own number (±2/±3 per game) silently becomes FBL fact points in player cards, team totals, standings and the in-season update. It is labelled as bonus-free FBL.
findings.fix: Have the UI mark such games («* ФО Sports.ru с бонусом за результат, предварительно») and say so in the overview, or keep them out of the FBL fact until box stats or a result arrive. At minimum, surface gamePoints.gamesWithoutResult in the season-tab status line.

findings.title: Published sports-current.json describes game points with the old +2/+1 minutes rule
findings.location: scripts/collect_sports_current.py:879 (out['gamePoints']['formula']); also the comments at :177-178 and :877-878
findings.claim: main() writes 'gamePoints': {'formula': 'FBL: PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK-(FGA-FGM)-(FTA-FTM)-2*TOV-PF, +2 for 10+ minutes, else +1'} into the published public/data/sports-current.json. The code itself uses GAME_PLAYED=1 per game. The adjacent comments describe the fallback as «Sports.ru's points minus the result bonus», leaving out the minutes point and the fact that the box score is the primary source.
findings.reproduction: repro.py, section 2 extracts the literal 'FBL: PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK-(FGA-FGM)-(FTA-FTM)-2*TOV-PF, +2 for 10+ minutes, else +1'. On the same row box_points returns 28 (the +1 rule), not the 29 that '+2 for 10+ minutes' implies. The deployed and live snapshots (main's older collector) still say 'FBL: Sports.ru without the team result bonus', so the next branch collection would publish the +2/+1 text.
findings.impact: Anyone reading the published data (the league, a later audit, downstream tools) is told FBL gives +2 for 10+ minutes, which is false since 21.10.
findings.fix: Set the string to 'FBL (Yahoo): PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK-(FGA-FGM)-(FTA-FTM)-2*TOV-PF+1 per game played, from the Sports.ru box score; fallback Sports.ru points minus result bonus and minus its 10+ minutes point'. Fix the two comments the same way.

findings.title: README defines the FBL formula as «Sports.ru's without the team result bonus», which still has Sports.ru's +2/+1 minutes rule
findings.location: README.md:9 (last sentence)
findings.claim: «The league scores on Yahoo with the FBL formula: Sports.ru's without the team result bonus.» Sports.ru's formula without the bonus still gives +2 for 10+ minutes and +1 below. Yahoo FBL gives +1 per game played.
findings.reproduction: repro.py, section 3, on the Jokic fixture row (18:15): Yahoo FBL 28, while «Sports.ru without the result bonus» gives 29 (build_forecasts.full = 28). On the 2025/26 league logs, 22,630 of 26,648 played games are 10+ minutes, so that definition overstates FBL by 0.849 FP a game on average.

findings.title: Sports.ru history check: "FBL" per game is Sports.ru's ФО minus average bonuses, although the career logs hold the box scores of the same games
findings.location: scripts/apply_sports_history.py:29-40 (result_bonuses) and :62-67 (fblPerGame = perGame - mean result bonus - mean 10-minute extra point); the fallback at :76-77 that uses Sports.ru's own number as the reference when there are no logs; values shown by src/main.js sportsHistoryPanel (column «Без бонуса — как считает FBL»), src/forecast-text.js sportsSeasonsLine/sportsCheckLine («по формуле FBL …») and src/insights.js trend and flag lines
findings.claim: fblPerGame is not computed with the Yahoo formula. It is reconstructed from Sports.ru's ФО per game by subtracting the mean Sports.ru result bonus and the mean extra point for 10+ minutes, both taken from data/raw/career_games.parquet. That same parquet holds the full box score of every one of those games. The reconstruction has three error sources: (a) result_bonuses averages over every NBA REGULAR row, including All-Star exhibition rows (teams STARS/STRIPES/WORLD …, which projection_model removes as EXHIBITION) and play-in games, neither of which Sports.ru scores; (b) the logs store minutes rounded to whole numbers, so 9:30-9:59 is read as 10 and an extra point is removed that Sports.ru never gave; (c) any deviation of Sports.ru's own scoring passes straight through.

findings.fix:
Compute fblPerGame directly with the formula on the logs and drop the subtraction, for example:

def fbl_seasons(path=LOGS):
    acc = {}
    for g in pq.read_table(path).to_pylist():
        if (g['competition'] != 'nba' or g['season_type'] != 'REGULAR'
                or g['team'] in EXHIBITION or g['opponent'] in EXHIBITION
                or g['date'] > LAST_REGULAR_DAY[g['season']]):
            continue
        key = (str(g['player_id']), f"{g['season'] - 1}-{str(g['season'])[2:]}")
        t, n = acc.get(key, (0, 0))
        acc[key] = (t + g['pts'] + g['reb'] + g['ast'] + g['stl'] + g['blk'] + g['fgm'] - g['fga'] + g['ftm'] - g['fta'] - 2 * g['tov'] - g['pf'] + GAME_PLAYED, n + 1)
    return {k: (t / n, n) for k, (t, n) in acc.items()}

Then in attach(): `v['fblPerGame'] = round(per, 2); v['fblGames'] = n` when the game counts agree.
- Reuse projection_model.EXHIBITION.
- Prefer the official league files for 2023-24 to 2025-26.
- Keep Sports.ru's own perGame for display only.
- Without logs, skip the check instead of comparing against Sports.ru's ФО.
- Update the 'reference' text, which today mentions only the result bonus.

findings.title: Forecast outputs and docs describe the FBL formula as "Sports.ru's without the result bonus", cite Sports.ru's rules page, and say participation is estimated
findings.location: scripts/projection_model.py:680 (projectionModelAudit.limitations, published as data/projection-model-audit.json); scripts/projection_model.py:40,785 (forecastNotes.rulesSource = Sports.ru rules page 150); scripts/build_forecasts.py:2-5 docstring, :23,133,138 (rulesSource), :149-150 (forecastAudit.limitations, published as forecast-audit.json); scripts/complete_forecasts.py:88 (rulesSource); scripts/inseason_calibration.py:205 and the generated data/inseason-calibration.json:11 (target); scripts/espn_context.py:32 (individualProjection.limitations 'Minute and game-result bonuses excluded.', stored for 313 players and in data/forecast-snapshots); README.md:9; comment at scripts/audit_scoring.py:79
findings.claim:
These statements are false:
- Sports.ru's formula gives +2 for 10+ minutes (+1 below) plus the result bonus. FBL (Yahoo) gives exactly +1 per game played. So FBL is not Sports.ru's formula minus the result bonus.
- The scoring authority is Yahoo (data/league-rules.json scoringAuthority and scoringFormula), not Sports.ru's rules page.
- Participation is a constant 1, not a 'historical-role estimate'.
- What ESPN's component total leaves out is PF and the +1 per game, not 'minute bonuses'.
findings.reproduction:
After the clean rebuild (check_v4.py on r2.final.json):
- forecastNotes.rulesSource and forecastAudit.rulesSource are 'https://www.sports.ru/fantasy/basketball/tournament/rules/150.html'.
- forecastAudit.limitations contains 'PF and participation are historical-role estimates.' and 'No team result bonus: the FBL formula is Sports.ru's without it …'.
- projectionModelAudit.limitations puts 'The participation term is 1 per game played (Yahoo GP)' next to 'the FBL formula is Sports.ru's without it'.
- grep shows the same wording in data/inseason-calibration.json 'target' ('FBL points per played game (Sports.ru formula without the team result bonus)') and in README.md:9 ('The league scores on Yahoo with the FBL formula: Sports.ru's without the team result bonus.').
findings.impact: The app does not render these texts. They are, however, in the published reports (projection-model-audit.json, which README names as the model report, and forecast-audit.json), in default-draft.json, in the calibration file bundled into the app, and in the README. A reader is told the wrong formula: Sports.ru's +2/+1 minutes rule would still apply.
findings.fix:
Use one wording everywhere, for example: 'FBL formula (Yahoo league settings): PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK+FGM-FGA+FTM-FTA-2*TO-PF, +1 per game played; no result bonus, no minutes rule.'
- Point rulesSource to data/league-rules.json#scoringFormula, the Yahoo settings.
- Change the build_forecasts limitation to 'PF is a historical-role estimate; participation is exactly 1 per game played'.
- Change the ESPN limitation to 'PF and the +1 per game played are not in ESPN's projection; build_forecasts adds them'.
- Regenerate data/inseason-calibration.json after editing the target string, otherwise --check fails.
- Fix README.md:9 and the audit_scoring comment.
